assignment_strategy: Always reconstruct and verify the exact durable pending stage before selecting a new optimizer family or candidate.
Bind every resumed stage to predecessor sequence, frozen root/config blobs, decision/precommit/critique blobs, selected variant and guard IDs.
Use only already-observed same-scope failure exemplars as critique inputs; exemplars cannot invent success/failure evidence, broaden scope, or create extra credit-bearing items.
Keep control, CLEAN, authority, zero-dependency, zero-quota and zero-incremental-cost fields immutable under textual mutation.
Evaluate only same-scope terminal behavior after durable readback; mechanical repository/rate-limit/CAS failures are transport diagnostics, not assignment-quality scores.
Permit at most one credit increment for one independently sealed terminal transition; duplicate or nonterminal evidence receives zero credit.

Use a bounded one-step synthesis for this resumed stage; if terminal evaluation fails or identity mismatches, preserve the blocker and switch only through the declared frontier rather than self-refining indefinitely.
